description: Sourced plan comparisons for a Canadian province, plus Starlink. Optional region: annapolis-valley (alias valley) or national (alias canada). Omit province for a summary of the published pages. A province without a local table returns only providers whose published pages list service there, plus Starlink. Read only.

province.description: Province or territory code or name, such as NS or Nova Scotia. Omit for the published summary.

region.description: Allowed: annapolis-valley, valley, national, canada. valley is an alias for annapolis-valley. canada is an alias for national. Omit for the province default.

name: compare_internet
title: Compare internet
